name: Fresh Sweet Italian Pork Sausage (Mild, Fennel Only)
whyItWorks: Seasoned with gentle sweet fennel seeds and salt, completely omitting red pepper flakes and hot paprika. When removed from casing and crumbled in a skillet with fat drained, it is well-tolerated in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slit casing, crumble sausage into skillet, cook until browned, and drain excess grease on paper towels.
